notes.title: A new solitaire demo is available!
notes.content:

notes.title: Wargame Comrades and Barons: Gates of Freedom has been released on 1st June
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31850498/2fb84a320ae82985d50a37d8078800728859837d.jpg[/img]

It's title is Comrades and Barons: Gates of Freedom and it is a real wargame about the Latvian War of Independence.

notes.title: Comrades and Barons: Solitaire is on sale / A new book on topic of Baltic Wars
notes.content:
[b]Comrades and Barons: Solitaire of Bloody 1919 [/b]is on sale this Halloween, along with my other games: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1014270/Plaguepunk_Justice/]Plaguepunk Justice[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1152420/Heraldry_Studio/]Heraldry Studio[/url].

In other news: I turns out that Osprey Publishing has released a uniformology book on Lithuanian, Latvian and Estonian armies of the period: "[b]Armies of the Baltic Independence Wars 1918-20[/b]" (Elite 227). Finally I can direct people who want to know more about the history to somewhere other than Wikipedia!

At least that was what I thought at first, but now I have doubts if I would actually recommend it.

[url=https://uniformologija.lv/domas/raksts/armies-of-the-baltic-independence-wars-1918-20/en]Read my thoughts about [b]Armies of the Baltic Independence Wars 1918-20[/b] here.[/url]

Thank you for reading, join our [url=https://discord.gg/StwnxP6]Discord channel[/url], if you like.
Bye!

notes.title: Heraldry Studio announcement + weekly sale of Comrades and Barons: Solitaire!
notes.content:
[b]Heraldry Studio[/b], a software that allows to create different coat of arms, will be released this month! It will come out on 23rd September. HS will be in Early Access for about a year, gradually filling with new features according to the community wishes. The link to the Steam store page is here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1152420/Heraldry_Studio/?curator_clanid=34886518
Wishlist and follow!

Meanwhile - [b]Comrades and Barons: Solitaire of Bloody 1919[/b], along with [b]Plaguepunk Justice[/b], are on sale this week. Tell your friends and family!

notes.title: A minor update
notes.content:
A minor update for Comrades and Barons: Solitaire of Bloody 1919 has been uploaded today:
1) annoying action tooltip that stayed on screen after clearing the table is gone,
2) added a new victory condition "Play through all tables" to make things clearer,
3) some minor updates to art,
4) some minor updates to translations.
